successCriteria.description: Jest unit tests exist under tests/unit/modules/{employee,leave-type,policy,balance,audit}/ named *.test.ts, and the full suite passes with the pg pool mocked (no real database connection is opened).

BalanceService counter transitions are covered and asserted: reserve (pendingDays += n), approve (pendingDays -= n, usedDays += n), reject pending (pendingDays -= n), cancel pending (pendingDays -= n), cancel approved (usedDays -= n).

The derived availability formula is asserted: getAvailableDays returns totalEntitlement - usedDays - pendingDays, and the repository mapRow derives remainingDays the same way (never read from a stored column).

Negative-guard behavior is asserted: every transition that would take a counter below zero (reserve/approve/reject/cancel with days exceeding the relevant counter, or negative days) throws InsufficientBalanceError and never clamps the counter to zero.

Repository tests assert snake_case→camelCase row mapping and the documented fallbacks: employmentStatus→'ACTIVE', unknown leave-type code→LeaveTypeCode.UNPAID, unknown audit action→'UPDATE', and balance remainingDays derived from the three counters.

Service tests assert validation/error behavior: EmployeeService.create rejects missing required fields and duplicate employeeNumber (ValidationError); PolicyService.create rejects missing policyName/leaveTypeId and negative entitlementDays (ValidationError); not-found paths throw NotFoundError; BalanceService not-found throws NotFoundError.

constraints: Tests must mock src/shared/db/connection.ts (jest.mock) and stub pool.query; no real PostgreSQL connection may be opened. Repositories accept an optional PoolClient as the last parameter, so tests may pass a stub client to bypass the pool.

Tests must import concrete classes and shared types via relative paths to src/... (e.g. ../../../../src/...), matching the existing tests/unit/shared/types/errors.test.ts convention and jest.config.js (testMatch '**/tests/**/*.test.(ts|js)', moduleDirectories ['node_modules','src']).

Assertions must match the actual method signatures and return shapes of the part-2 implementations (e.g. BalanceService.cancel takes requestStatus 'PENDING'|'APPROVED'; repository methods take optional client as last param; services default-construct concrete repositories).
No leave-type service exists — only PgLeaveTypeRepository is tested under tests/unit/modules/leave-type/. No test may assume a leave-type service.
outOfScope: The leave module orchestrator (LeaveService, countLeaveDays, overlap detection, transaction wiring across leave_requests/leave_balances/audit_logs) — Phase 4.
Controllers, routes, RBAC guards, and any HTTP surface for the five leaf modules.
The notification module and its tests (Phase 3).
Integration tests against a real database; this phase is unit tests only with a mocked pool.

entityInvariants.invariant: remainingDays is always derived as totalEntitlement - usedDays - pendingDays and never persisted; the repository's INSERT/UPDATE omit remaining_days and mapRow recomputes it.
No counter (usedDays, pendingDays) may go negative; a transition that would take one below zero throws InsufficientBalanceError rather than clamping. Negative guards live only in BalanceService.
On every write, status is recomputed: CLOSED is preserved; otherwise EXHAUSTED when remainingDays <= 0, else ACTIVE.
AuditLog is immutable: the repository exposes only create/read (no update/delete), and AuditService.record sets performedAt at write time and allows performedBy to be null.
employmentStatus is one of ACTIVE|INACTIVE|TERMINATED; on read, an unknown status falls back to 'ACTIVE'. terminate() transitions to TERMINATED and sets terminationDate (defaulting to now).
entitlementDays must be non-negative (create and update reject negative values with ValidationError); deactivate() sets isActive=false without deleting.

interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws NotFoundError if balance missing; InsufficientBalanceError if days < 0 or days > availableDays. On success pendingDays += days.
Throws NotFoundError if balance missing; InsufficientBalanceError if days < 0 or pendingDays < days. On success pendingDays -= days and usedDays += days.
Throws NotFoundError if balance missing; InsufficientBalanceError if days < 0 or pendingDays < days. On success pendingDays -= days.

Throws NotFoundError if balance missing; InsufficientBalanceError if days < 0, or if the relevant counter (pendingDays for PENDING, usedDays for APPROVED) is below days. On success PENDING releases pendingDays -= days; APPROVED restores usedDays -= days.
Pure derivation totalEntitlement - usedDays - pendingDays; never reads a stored remainingDays.
Throws ValidationError if employeeNumber/firstName/lastName/email missing, or if employeeNumber already exists. On success creates with a generated id.
Throws ValidationError if policyName or leaveTypeId missing, or entitlementDays < 0. On success creates with generated id and createdAt/updatedAt set to now.
Sets performedAt at write time, coerces oldValues/newValues/performedBy to null when absent, and persists via repository.create.

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Balance counter semantics and derived availability must match the BalanceService implementation exactly (reserve/approve/reject/cancel transitions, negative guards, status recomputation).
Repository row mapping and fallbacks (employmentStatus→ACTIVE, leave-type code→UNPAID, audit action→UPDATE, balance remainingDays derived) must match the concrete repository mapRow implementations.
Error types and their code/statusCode (ValidationError 400, NotFoundError 404, InsufficientBalanceError 422) must be asserted against the shared error classes.
LeaveTypeCode values (including UNPAID fallback) must be asserted against the shared enum.
The pg pool must be mocked via jest.mock on the connection module; repositories default to the shared pool when no client is passed.

integrationPoints.why: The pg pool every repository defaults to; must be mocked so no real DB access occurs.
Error classes asserted in service tests (ValidationError, NotFoundError, InsufficientBalanceError).
LeaveTypeCode (incl. UNPAID fallback) asserted in leave-type repository tests.
